Method of Attack: Ransomware disguised as a click me game that encrypts files using AES encryption and appends the .hacked extension; encrypts the file located at D:\ransom-flag.png
Impacted Systems: Windows systems with D: drive containing ransom-flag.png file
Attack Vector: Execution of ransomware disguised as a click me game
Indicators of Compromise: Encrypted file with .hacked extension; ransom note screen with Anonymous picture and Farsi text
